cues.text: Section thirteen: relevant archived pre-test and continuous assessment questions.
The following items directly test concepts taught in this session.
The original numbering and option order are preserved.
The suggested answers are tutor explanations, not official marking keys.
Questions that primarily test introductory IT management principles, governance standards, service management, resilience, or topics from later sessions have been excluded.
We begin with the pre-test questions.
Pre-test question 1.
Strategic alignment in IT ensures that blank.
Option a: technology initiatives support and reflect the broader business direction.
Option b: projects are executed based on available IT skills rather than organisational need.
Option c: innovation is prioritised over compliance and structure.
Option d: technical teams manage projects with complete autonomy from leadership.
The suggested answer is a.
Strategic alignment makes IT initiatives serve organisational strategy and business objectives.
Pre-test question 4.
Which of the following is the most accurate description of how ERP systems improve operational efficiency?
Option a: they block unauthorised internet access in the office.
Option b: they centralise data and automate business processes across departments.
Option c: they serve as internal messaging platforms.
Option d: they replace the need for customer service agents.
The suggested answer is b.
Enterprise Resource Planning integrates cross-departmental data and automates workflows.
Pre-test question 10.
A large retailer deploys predictive analytics to forecast customer purchasing trends, enabling them to optimise inventory levels and reduce overstocking.
This is an example of blank.
Option a: IT driving operational efficiency through data-driven decision-making.
Option b: IT investments reducing workforce morale.
Option c: IT being used for regulatory compliance.
Option d: IT outsourcing for supply chain security.
The suggested answer is a.
Predictive analytics informs stocking decisions and improves efficiency.
Now we move to the questions matched from the continuous assessment, or CA.
CA question 4.
Which of the following is a component of IT strategy?
Option A: using social media posts.
Option B: basic manual filing systems.
Option C: complex event planning activities.
Option D: data strategy and analytics.
The suggested answer is D.
Data strategy determines how information is collected, governed and analysed to achieve business objectives.
The other options are isolated activities rather than strategic components.
CA question 8.
During an IT service strategy review at MTN Nigeria Communications Plc, the enterprise architecture team identified conflicting investments in network monitoring tools.
What is the most appropriate strategic approach to resolve overlapping tool capabilities?
Option A: rationalise the tool portfolio through a capability and cost-benefit analysis.
Option B: purchase both tools and allow each department to choose independently.
Option C: retire all monitoring tools and rely on manual log checks.
Option D: outsource network monitoring to an unvetted third-party provider.
The suggested answer is A.
Application portfolio rationalisation compares capabilities, duplication, costs and business value before deciding what to retain, consolidate or retire.
CA question 22.
Why is cybersecurity part of IT strategy?
Option A: to improve internal office lighting.
Option B: to manage digital data risks.
Option C: to reduce internal server sizes.
Option D: to lower internal printing costs.
The suggested answer is B.
Cybersecurity protects information assets and reduces the likelihood and impact of digital risks.
It must be planned alongside business investments.
